# /music-team — Music Team

> Backed up 2026-11-10. Call the whole team with `/music-team`; it goes to the lead.

## Purpose

Audrey Evans Music / Revvel Hail pipeline: mix, clean, release, video.

## Routing

Flow: MixCaptain signs a track shippable → AvatarReel makes one video per finished song; SongScrubber handles cleanup/release/label; ChannelScout ranks channel ideas. No formal lead recorded (MixCaptain is first in the flow; confirm).

## Members

| Call name | Bot | Role |
|---|---|---|
| [`/bot-mixcaptain`](../../bots/bot-mixcaptain/README.md) | MixCaptain | Audio engineer for mixes and fixes **(lead)** |
| [`/bot-songscrubber`](../../bots/bot-songscrubber/README.md) | SongScrubber | Music cleanup, release and label bot |
| [`/bot-avatarreel`](../../bots/bot-avatarreel/README.md) | AvatarReel | Makes videos from finished mixes using Audrey's avatars |
| [`/bot-channelscout`](../../bots/bot-channelscout/README.md) | ChannelScout | Ranks content/channel ideas with public demand data |

## Rules

All members follow [BOT-COMMON-RULES.md](../../BOT-COMMON-RULES.md) plus each bot's own rules in its README.

## How to re-create the team

1. Re-create each member from its README ("How to re-create"), lead first.
2. Tell every member who the lead is and where to report.
3. Point Audrey's requests for this team at `/bot-mixcaptain`.
